% tocloft's \newlistof with hyperref. hyperref.exp is the list that
% pdflatex wrote for this document, with hyperref's four-argument
% \contentsline.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tocloft}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\newlistof{example}{exp}{Examples}
\newcommand{\example}[1]{\refstepcounter{example}\par\noindent Example~\theexample: #1%
  \addcontentsline{exp}{example}{\protect\numberline{\theexample}#1}\par}
\begin{document}
\listofexample
\section{First}
Text of the first section.
\example{A new example}
\end{document}
